cases.name: Laura Rose Crowley
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Attorney Laura R. Crowley was a native New Yorker who received a Bachelor of Science Nursing Degree from SUNY in 1981. After moving to Indiana, Attorney Crowley returned to school and was awarded her J.D. from Indiana University School of Law Indianapolis in December 1999. She has handled Medical Negligence cases for over 14 years. Her nursing experience, which includes Emergency Room and Operating Room, played a key role in her evaluation and work up of cases.

Laura was a partner in the law firm Lee Cossell & Crowley in Indianapolis. Attorney Crowley was a sustaining member of the Indiana Trial Lawyers Association and has served as a member of the faculty in Continuing Legal Education through that organization. She was a member of both national professional organizations, which included the American Association for Justice and the National Trial Lawyers: Top 100, as well as the local Indianapolis Bar Association. Her litigation experience included more than one dozen jury trials, several as first chair. She had drafted numerous Appellate briefs and had argued before the Indiana Supreme Court.

Attorney Crowley currently served as Vice President on the Board of the St. Thomas More Free Clinic which provides free medical care to the uninsured and under insured residents of Morgan County. She enjoyed teaching and working with law students and High School Students and had volunteered as judge for Client Counseling, Moot Court and the National High School Mock Trial Championship in May 2013. She was a member of St. Martin of Tours Catholic Church in Martinsville."
cases.narrative: On 1/1/2019, her adult son discovered their bodies.
